name: delinea
description: Work with Delinea Secret Server and the Delinea Platform from Claude: find and use secrets without exposing passwords, run SQL reports, and manage folders, users, groups, roles and access requests.

platform_hostname.title: Required: Delinea Platform URL
platform_hostname.description: Your Delinea Platform tenant, e.g. https://example.delinea.app. The Secret Server URL is found from it automatically. Only for a standalone Secret Server that isn't on the Delinea Platform: leave this empty and set the Secret Server URL override under the optional settings.

delinea_username.title: Required: Client ID
delinea_username.description: The client ID of your Delinea Platform service account. For a standalone Secret Server: the username of a Secret Server Application Account (Secret Server 12.1+ blocks password sign-in for regular users by default).

delinea_password.title: Required: Client secret
delinea_password.description: The client secret of the service account above (for a standalone Secret Server, the account's password). Stored in your operating system's secure credential store.

tool_preset.title: Required: Tool access
tool_preset.description: What Claude can do. Read-only: search, view secrets with passwords masked, run reports, and hand credentials to programs without showing them; nothing in Secret Server or the Platform is changed. All tools: also create, update, rotate and delete. Custom: only the tools in the custom tool list below.

enabled_tools.title: Required for Custom tool access: Custom tool list
enabled_tools.description: Only used when Tool access is Custom; leave blank otherwise. Comma-separated tool names, for example get_secret,search_secrets,get_secret_environment_variable.

delinea_base_url.title: Optional: Secret Server URL override
delinea_base_url.description: Leave empty to use the Secret Server vault your Delinea Platform tenant reports. Set it only to use a different vault, or for a standalone Secret Server, e.g. https://example.secretservercloud.com or https://ss.example.com/SecretServer.

allow_plaintext_reveal.title: Optional: Allow revealing passwords
allow_plaintext_reveal.description: Off by default. When on, Claude can show a masked password or key in plaintext, but only after you approve a prompt each time. Credentials can always be used without being shown.

platform_service_account.title: Optional: Separate Platform service account
platform_service_account.description: Leave empty to use the client ID above for the Platform user, role and report tools too. Only set it to use a different account for them.

platform_service_password.title: Optional: Separate Platform service account secret
platform_service_password.description: Only with a separate Platform service account above. Stored in your operating system's secure credential store.

platform_tenant_id.title: Optional: Platform secondary tenant ID (rarely needed)
platform_tenant_id.description: Leave empty. Only for multi-tenant Platform setups where the service account must act inside a specific child tenant.
